name: Bisiklet
scene: An elegant vintage bicycle stands against flowing sky and ground bands in a round-arched stained-glass panel.
notes: Target 36–46 panes. Bicycle frame, saddle, handlebar and wheel rims use the warm subject pair; background and wheel openings use the teal pair. Generated twice and visually reviewed; second design selected for simpler large panes and white exterior. Remaining doubts: subtle shading persists and the lower crank/frame pane blends amber into vermilion; some touching subject segments share a colour, and narrow triangular gaps remain at rear frame/wheel contacts. These require attention during tracing; no production geometry validation claimed. No obvious loose line ends; inspect close T junctions and wheel/ground contacts at tracing scale.
